note: What a server sends to show one of a client's own fixed announcements for five seconds.

fields.name: announcement
fields.note: Which of the client's 28 announcements, 0 to 27. The text of each is the client's own and is not recorded here; a client fails on any other value.

fields.name: unit
fields.note: A unit whose name the announcement carries, or zero for an announcement that names none. A client shows nothing where it does not know the unit.
